approaches.title: Find the common leading-bit prefix
approaches.summary: Determine the shared leading bits of the range endpoints, stopping at the first differing bit; all lower bits are zero in the range AND. The implementations progressively simplify how that prefix is identified.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 201: rly thought this would work
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Computes the endpoint intersection and retains its leading consecutive one-bits, returning zero when the endpoints have different leading-zero counts.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Simplifies common-prefix detection by repeatedly right-shifting both endpoints until they match, then restores the removed bit positions.
